summary: Prepared the current MY SGG Player OS for an owner-authorized public production release. Replaced the only ambiguous direct-delivery brand mark with a materially recomposed OpenAI Image 2.0 v002 emblem (one torii and exactly seven golden seals), preserved prompt/source/alpha/final-hash evidence, and removed the old runtime file. Rebuilt the active release registry from the exact public tree: 73 validator-supported images now have approved mirrors and manifest hashes, while PRODUCTION_IMAGE_INDEX.csv accounts for all 74 runtime images including ICO; the 130-row legacy registry remains immutable under assets/history. The asset pack passes draft validation and release-mode validation has only the intentional project-status REVIEW gate; all prior 285 structural asset errors are resolved. Application verification passes drizzle check, lint, typecheck, fresh production build, migration packaging parity, and all 98 tests. A read-only owner-D1 query confirmed migration 0007 is already applied with the expected tournament_results table/index/schema and 52 rows, with changed_db=false and rows_written=0, so no migration will be reapplied. Unrelated untracked creator references and tournament PII exports remain excluded from the release.
current_objective: Commit and push the validated release, deploy the owner Worker without changing access or D1 data, then verify and record the public production result.

blockers.description: This Codex task exposes the Browser skill but not its required in-app browser control capability after mandatory discovery. The existing protected production tab remains untouched. Version 14 has Sites screenshot, production HTTP, asset-hash, HTML/CSS and Worker-log evidence, but no new muted tab, interactive 390px viewport or console session was available.
blockers.resolution_required: Expose the supported Codex in-app browser control capability, then open the exact Version 14 URL in a new muted tab without navigating or closing the protected tab and complete desktop, 390px, interaction and console verification.

blockers.description: A separate owner-run session implements Discord login inside the OTOMO CHAIN 7 repository; its server side is committed and deployed with the feature disabled while its web side was still uncommitted. Writing there from this session would destroy concurrent work, and that session's git housekeeping has already deleted an untracked directory created here, so generated assets are produced outside the repository until they are committed.
blockers.resolution_required: Confirm the OTOMO CHAIN work is committed and its export shape final before this session adapts dashboard reconciliation or edits that repository.

blockers.description: SGP amounts per final rank are an official reward decision and are not recorded. The deployed payout endpoint requires an operator-supplied award table and rejects any request without one.
blockers.resolution_required: Decide and record the season-0 SGP award table, then pass it explicitly to the payout dry run before any apply=true request.

blockers.description: Automated tests and production smoke cover the DM protocol and fail-closed guards, but no real user DM was sent and a two-account isolation test requires interactive access to two consenting Discord identities.
blockers.resolution_required: Done 2026-07-31: real two-account test (owner + type.wolf). Client-side four-point check and server-side row inspection agree; tester's email removed from the Access policy immediately after.

blockers.description: Production moved to the owner-owned Worker at my.sevengodsgames.com behind Cloudflare Access with a single allowed email. Public or shared access, additional viewers, search indexing and public release remain unauthorized; the old Sites Version 14 stays frozen as rollback.
blockers.resolution_required: Done 2026-07-31: the owner explicitly ordered immediate public release for the 8/1 tournament and personally executed the access-widening step (deleting the Access application) after the permission boundary correctly stopped Claude from doing it. Isolation, rollback, domain, dependency and screen gates were each verified and recorded across CP-000042..049.

blockers.description: No game currently exposes the required side-effect-free signed player snapshot contract, so in-game progress and resources remain intentionally unconnected. On-chain wallet holdings are separate and do not depend on this bridge.
blockers.resolution_required: Implement and review the documented short-lived audience-bound assertion and player snapshot contract per game before connecting in-game data.

blockers.description: Stable Next and Miniflare still require Sharp 0.34.5, which npm audit flags for inherited libvips advisories. The built Worker has no Sharp or libvips import and the application has no untrusted image-processing path, so the documented owner-only non-reachable exception remains in force.
blockers.resolution_required: Upgrade when stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare officially support patched Sharp; reassess immediately if image upload or server-side untrusted processing is added.

blockers.description: Sites Version 14 predates /api/admin/export, and its D1 lives in an account the owner cannot reach, so legacy ledger data cannot be extracted by any available means. The owner confirmed there was no real usage, so nothing of value is stranded; recording this so a future request to recover it is not attempted as if possible.
blockers.resolution_required: None. Confirmed unrecoverable and confirmed empty of real usage; the new production starts clean.

blockers.description: The working Discord client secret was rendered in plaintext by the developer portal and captured in a session screenshot before it could be avoided. It is valid and in use.
blockers.resolution_required: Done: rotated 2026-07-31 via a localhost receiver so the value never entered Claude's context, verified against Discord, and re-tested through a full login.
